verdicts.reason: A: the 'LONGEST DAY SALE' banner is shrunk into an unreadable sticker at the bottom, the phone is cut off at the top edge, and the CTA pushes into the end of the headline ('last'). The legal line is also as prominent as the body copy. B: the sale banner stays readable and the phone is shown whole, but the bottom row is cramped: '25% off on June 21.' and the legal text are squeezed on either side of the CTA, the legal text sits near the right edge, and the banner is jammed into the bottom-left corner over the decorative circle.
